integrity: A self-contained event-classification proof covers all permitted graph sizes. Two separately implemented exhaustive programs reproduce finite cases; no independent external scientific audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to synchronous three-color successor-contact dynamics on K_n minus k disjoint edges, with n-k>=4; it does not classify per-orbit basin sizes, arbitrary missing-edge graphs, or other update rules. A previously established complete-multipartite period restriction is background, not new.
title: Linear orbit loss and quadratic delayed waves in matching-defected cliques
